policy: These are research-source candidates, not automatically approved feeds or evidence. A generated article may use a source only when a source-specific factual brief is included with the candidate and its reuse conditions have been reviewed. Do not infer facts from a source name or URL.

sources.name: F1Technical.net
sources.role: Technical reporting and discussion; verify factual claims against the linked report.

sources.name: Racecar Engineering
sources.role: Engineering journalism and technical features.

sources.name: Formu1a.uno
sources.role: Italian-language F1 reporting, including reported technical developments.

sources.name: ScarbsTech
sources.role: Technical explanations and illustrations; use as background, not proof of team intent.

sources.name: F1 Data Analytics
sources.role: Data visualizations and analysis; retain the stated dataset and methodology.

sources.name: Motorsport Technology
sources.role: Motorsport technology and data-science coverage.

sources.name: StatsF1
sources.role: Historical F1 statistics; verify season and event context.

sources.name: Ergast Developer API
sources.role: Historical results API reference; current data access is handled separately through the configured Jolpica connection.

sources.name: OpenF1
sources.role: Session data API candidate; do not use until data-use terms and fields are reviewed.

sources.name: FastF1 Documentation
sources.role: Library documentation, not a standalone licence for upstream timing data.

sources.name: BlackBook Motorsport
sources.role: Motorsport business and sponsorship reporting.

sources.name: SportBusiness
sources.role: Sports industry and business reporting; check article access and reuse terms.

sources.name: Joe Saward / The Green Notebook
sources.role: Paddock commentary and reporting; attribute claims and preserve opinion as opinion.

sources.name: Decalspotters
sources.role: Livery and sponsor-mark tracking; distinguish observed marks from sponsorship deal terms.

sources.name: Forbes SportsMoney
sources.role: Business and valuation reporting; label estimates and attribute them.

sources.name: RaceFans Live
sources.role: Live session timing context; not a general article feed or a substitute for a licensed timing provider.

sources.name: F1Bytes
sources.role: Data-led newsletter analysis; preserve its methodology and do not restate analysis as official fact.

sources.name: GP Racing Magazine
sources.role: Interviews and long-form features; use only source-approved briefs.

sources.name: Project F1
sources.role: Data modelling and race-pace analysis; attribute methods and scope.

sources.role: Statistics and milestone archive; verify dates and underlying records.
